items.question: What qualities are attributed to one whose birth occurs under the vijaya-named condition?
premises: The verse lists giver and compassionate.
items.inference: The verse attributes generosity, compassion, and enemy-slaying to one born under vijaya.
uncertainties: The exact scope of vijaya-named birth is unclear.
items.plain_english: A giver, compassionate, indeed an enemy-slayer—whose birth is under the vijaya-named.
